title: Kissed Roasted Thai Tofu Boat Noodles
description: A quick-fix Thai dish featuring roasted tofu and fast action yeast, served in a lacquerware bowl, this vegetarian-friendly boat noodle dish is a twist on traditional Thai cuisine. It combines the crunch of double-fry KFC style tofu with the comfort of a warm, spicy broth.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the tofu cubes with 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
In a large pot, combine the coconut milk, Thai red curry paste, and fast action yeast, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the curry broth for 10 minutes.
While the broth is simmering, cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a deep frying pan, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium-high heat and double-fry the roasted tofu until crispy and golden brown.
To assemble the boat noodles, place some cooked noodles in the bottom of a lacquerware bowl, followed by a few pieces of the double-fry tofu, some bean sprouts, and a sprinkle of chopped scallions.
Ladle the hot curry broth over the top of the noodles and garnish with a lime wedge.
